capabilities: Create a hidden hub note for each folder
Insert links to hub notes at the top of notes
Keep folder nodes and links updated as the vault changes
Customize the hub workflow through settings
extras: Obsidian's directory notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; install is manual (copying main.js and manifest.json into a plugin folder).
intentEvidence: Automatically creates and maintain's a graph view of your notes, if their organized into folders
problem: Obsidian's graph view only shows notes and their links, so a vault organized into folders has no visual representation of that folder structure.
summary: Creates hidden hub notes for each folder so the graph view shows folders as root nodes that connect the notes inside them.
